ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: U.S. Media Influence on Globalism. This course will provide an examination of how U.S. media has influenced global relations and will offer overviews of perceptions of the United States by other countries and perspectives on other nations by Americans. It will trace the development of the Internet and how it has changed the world, but will also look at television, the cinema, newspapers, and magazines. Students will be asked to complete readings before class. Readings discussions will be mixed with instructor lectures. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
